detail.title: Flow-State as an Emergent Preference
detail.summary: Evidence suggests that users have a persistent, stable preference for 'flow' states—defined as a balance between task difficulty and skill. AI systems aiming to support this preference must avoid disrupting this state with static or intrusive interventions.
detail.reason: Synthesis of existing sources regarding flow theory and cognitive augmentation.
